title: About
text: I am an interdisciplinary researcher with training in clinical pharmacy and current expertise in statistical genetics and applied bioinformatics for the analysis of large-scale genomic and health data. My research focuses on computational and statistical methods for complex human disease, with particular emphasis on polygenic modelling, fine-mapping, gene–environment analyses, and reproducible analysis of large-scale genomic and register-based data. I combine method-oriented quantitative research with translational interpretation of biological and clinical questions, and I have active teaching experience in applied data analysis and programming, including PhD-level instruction in R.

title: About
text:
Background
My path into statistical genetics started in clinical practice. I trained as a pharmacist (Pharm.D., Isfahan University of Medical Sciences, 2010–2016) and worked as a clinical pharmacist at Alzahra Hospital while completing a Ph.D. in Clinical Pharmacy (2016–2023). During that time my interests moved toward the quantitative and computational side of health research, which led me to a visiting researcher position at the Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG), Aarhus University, in 2022. I have been based in Aarhus ever since, joining the National Centre for Register-based Research (NCRR) as a postdoctoral researcher in June 2024. This background is part of why I care about keeping statistical and computational work connected to the underlying clinical and biological questions.

title: About
text:
Teaching
I am course developer, course leader, and instructor for Basic R (PhD level) at Aarhus University — responsible for course design, teaching materials, and delivery. The course was first offered in 2026, with deliveries in April and December. I also lead and teach Advanced R (PhD level), an established PhD course at Aarhus University, from 2026.
I completed the University Pedagogical Programme at Aarhus University in spring 2026.
Earlier in my career I was a teaching assistant in Clinical Pharmacy Practice and Community Pharmacy Practice at Isfahan University of Medical Sciences (2017–2021).

title: About
text:
Supervision and mentoring
I am currently co-supervising three PhD research projects in statistical genetics and epidemiology at Aarhus University. Previously, I co-supervised five PharmD and PhD projects on drug safety, dialysis outcomes, and depression in diabetes.

title: About
text:
Honors and service
I received the European Society of Human Genetics (ESHG) Fellowship for European Countries in 2025, and was nominated for the ESHG Best Poster Award the same year. In 2020, I ranked first in the Clinical Pharmacy Board Examination.
I regularly review for journals spanning genetics and pharmacy practice, including Brain Communications, Scientific Reports, and the Journal of Research in Pharmacy Practice, and I contribute to academic organisation and collaborative research activities within the Aarhus University research environment.
For the complete, dated record of appointments, education, teaching, and service, see my CV. For my papers and preprints, see Publications.
